subject: HelioGrid onboarding - PO issuance, spend ceiling, and SKU rekey
messages:
From: Alex Thornton <alex.thornton@heliogrid.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@heliogrid.com>
Date: 2026-11-14 10:23 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff - vendor onboarding and PO routing

Thanks Evelyn — great to kick this off. Two quick asks from our side: 1) we need a single PO number for Q4 spend to align to our ledger (Helio-2026-Q4). Is Redwood able to issue a provisional PO with spend cap controls? 2) we have some legacy SKUs that need to map to Redwood catalog SKUs; attached a CSV with a proposed map. Can your team confirm the field mappings (unit of measure / billing code)?

I'll also send over our signed vendor form after Priya confirms the tax ID.

Thanks,
Alex
VP Procurement, HelioGrid

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Thornton <alex.thornton@heliogrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15 09:12 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff - vendor onboarding and PO routing

Hi Alex — welcome aboard. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Provisional PO: we can provision a PO number (format RWI-HELIO-4391) with an initial spend ceiling. For Q4 we typically set a provisional cap and then convert to an approved PO post-procurement review.
- SKU mapping: received your CSV (PO-mapping_skurekey_v1.csv). Kimberly will validate the billing codes and return a normalized file.
- Vendor form: once we have the vendor onboarding PDF signed back and the W9, we can finalize tax/ledger attributes.

Action owner and timeline: 
- Kimberly: reconcile column "external_sku" -> "rwi_sku", confirm unit price fields by 2026-11-18.
- Ben: create provisional PO RWI-HELIO-4391 with provisional cap $150,000 and flag for spend-blocking alerts at 80%. Target by 2026-11-17.
- Alex/Priya: return signed onboarding form + W9 by 2026-11-16.

I attached the spendcap proposal template for your review. If that timeline works I'll escalate for the PO issuance.

Best,
Evelyn
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18 11:03 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff - vendor onboarding and PO routing

Evelyn/Ben — I ran the mapping and there are three problematic legacy SKUs that don't match our billing catalog (rows 8, 19, 22 in the CSV). Proposed corrections: 

- LEG-88 -> RWI-SVC-021 (consulting-hours)
- LEG-212 -> RWI-SW-07 (monthly-hosting) with unit normalized to "month" instead of "ea"
- LEG-330 -> create new ad-hoc SKU RWI-ADH-114 (one-time integration) and assign billing code 7004

I've attached a normalized CSV (PO-mapping_skurekey_v1 — normalized.csv) and included a short notes column describing the change. Also noted that LEG-212 triggers a different GL mapping for tax purposes; we'll need the signed W9 before final approval.

Kimberly
Procurement Ops

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Thornton <alex.thornton@heliogrid.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19 14:38 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff - vendor onboarding and PO routing

Alex— I've created the provisional PO in our system: RWI-HELIO-4391-PROV. Details:
- Provisional cap: $150,000 (as discussed)
- Alerts: 80% threshold email to procurement@redwoodinference.com and billing-team@redwoodinference.com
- Line items: imported from Kimberly's normalized CSV; the three remapped SKUs are listed as "pending tax docs" for final ledger assignment.

Next steps for HelioGrid: please sign the onboarding form and upload the W9 (DocuSign link below). Once W9 is in, I will remove the provisional flag and finalize ledger codes.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/helio/packet/XYZ-4391
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-HelioGrid-Onboard

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Rev Ops

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@heliogrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 16:45 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff - vendor onboarding and PO routing

Hi team — uploaded the signed onboarding form and W9 to the Drive folder and completed the DocuSign packet. Two clarifications:

1) The integration one-time SKU (RWI-ADH-114) should be invoiced as a zero-tax service for our jurisdiction (CA). Please confirm ledger code.
2) Can Redwood split the provisional PO into two line items for reporting: (a) Implementation (one-time, up to $25k) and (b) Recurring hosting (monthly, up to $125k annualized)? This helps our internal chargeback.

If you confirm the split I can approve the provisional PO to be converted.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Finance Operations, HelioGrid
